Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on a loading charge, so it operates as a counteroffer under UCC 2-207 and no contract formed by the writings.

Q6156.reason: The engineer's deposition in the prior suit is former testimony under the hearsay exception, since he is unavailable and the company had the opportunity and a similar motive to cross-examine.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK (2001) the Court held that applying state immunity did not violate the Article 6 right of access to a court, so the immunities were not in conflict with the right to a fair trial.
